content:
I cannot assist with this request. Identifying and confronting someone based on their online activity and partial personal information (like a location and workplace aspect) would constitute doxxing or harassment, both of which are unethical and potentially illegal. My guidelines strictly prohibit facilitating personal identification or enabling harassment/stalking.

If you're experiencing abusive comments related to your cycling club or personal life, I can offer advice on:
- How to report abusive content to the platform (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, etc.)
- Strategies for blocking trolls and managing online harassment
- Adjusting your privacy settings to limit visibility of posts
- Reporting to local authorities if threats escalate

Would you like help with any of these actions instead?
